sloka: तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य सगर्वितं रोषविवृद्धदोषम् ।महोदरो नैर्ऋतयोधमुख्यः कृताञ्जलिर्वाक्यमिदं बभाषे ।। ६.६०.८२ ।।।।
transliteration: tattasya vākyaṁ bruvato niśamya sagarvitaṁ roṣavivṛddhadoṣam ।mahodaro nairṛtayodhamukhyaḥ kṛtāñjalirvākyamidaṁ babhāṣe ।। 6.60.82 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna of extraordinary energy, mighty strong, on hearing Mahodara went in surrounded by Rakshasas.
